description: A Campaign is a grouping of adversarial behaviors that describes a set of malicious activities or attacks (sometimes called waves) that occur over a period of time against a specific set of targets. Campaigns usually have well defined objectives and may be part of an Intrusion Set. Clusters imported from STIX Campaign objects. Each cluster keeps the STIX version of the object it comes from (2.0, 2.1, ...) in its `spec_version` meta field.
name: STIX Campaign
